tests.name: catalog: eight finite regions and reachable unlock graph
fresh profile: town, initial dice, one open region
gates: locked dice and locked regions reject launch without spending
launch: one immutable main die and configured slots
launch save failure: no run published and no attempt consumed
one active expedition: second launch is rejected
real battle: all stages, two minibosses and final boss, then victory
boss cannot be skipped by the wave timer
approach wave must clear before spawning a boss
boss breach: defeat even with spare health, no victory flag
victory requires actual final-boss kill
victory: fixed rewards, first-clear blueprint, one lead-die gear
settlement idempotency: duplicate callback cannot double rewards
settlement write failure: wallet unchanged until retry succeeds
crash after terminal snapshot: load retries unconfirmed settlement
crash after confirmed settlement: reload does not pay twice
repeat same lead: reward resources, no duplicate gear / first clear
different lead: exactly one extra gear, not all carried dice
defeat keeps collected resource / blueprint, no region clear
abandon at t=0 cannot farm dispatch supplies
endless lock is effective at the terminal boundary
endless: keeps build, uses new journal identity, pays only new loot
endless final stage wraps and never grants another normal victory
blueprint RNG is independent of combat RNG
boss blueprint draws are deduplicated within the run
pinned region definition and bonuses survive authoring changes
resume: exact battle and reward RNG continuation
suspend to town: building prohibited and resume keeps offer
building construction: cost once, rewards only on completion
building write failure does not spend funds or publish construction
construction rejects resource tiles, occupied plots and locked blueprints
relocation preserves level and work without replaying reward
town bounce advances construction and reaches a finite end
town state checkpoint: no repeated resource on reload
town dispatch cannot overlap expedition or another dispatch
new cycle uses configured gate and preserves permanent unlocks
legacy save migration: retain previously usable six-dice deck
legacy active run migration: not replaced or restarted
invalid save: no silent overwrite
mismatched active session is rejected on load
catalog validation rejects unknown region / blueprint references
catalog detects circular building prerequisites
upgrade exhaustion: no invalid three-choice modal or capped upgrade
terminal callback flood cannot block settlement
configuration: no character-unlock state or six-die clear multiplication
